name: PCF Shadow Lookup with Slope Scaling and Edge Fade
aliases: PCF with Slope Scaling and Edge Fade
definition: Computes sun shadow occlusion at a world position using a comparison sampler and a dynamic PCF kernel, with slope-scaled depth bias and distance-based edge fading to prevent peter-panning and hard shadow edges.
summary: PCF Shadow Lookup with Slope Scaling and Edge Fade computes shadow occlusion using dynamic normal-offset bias and smooth edge fading to prevent peter-panning and harsh shadow boundaries.
